body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for identifying at least one abnormal biomedical feature[[s]] within at least one image[[s]] of biomedical data, the apparatus comprising:an image capture device configured to capture the at least one [[an]] image of biomedical data pertaining to a first patient;
a processor communicatively connected to the image capture device;
a memory communicatively connected to the processor, wherein the memory contains instructions configuring the processor to:
receive the at least one image of biomedical data from the image capture device;
extract a plurality of biomedical features from the biomedical data;
receive repository data from a medical repository as a function of the plurality of biomedical features;
generate at least [[a]] one distance metric as a function of the plurality of biomedical features and the repository data; [[and]] highlight the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image as a function of the at least [[a]] one distance metric; [[and]] identify within the medical repository at least one second patient associated with at least one similar distance metric, wherein:a first set of statistical parameters are extracted as a function of the at least one image, and at least one second set of statistical parameters are extracted as a function of at least one image associated with the at least one second patient; and
identifying the at least one second patient comprises matching the first set of statistical parameters with the at least one second set of statistical parameters using a statistical model; and
a display device communicatively connected to the processor, wherein the display device is configured to display the at least [[a]] one highlighted abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image.
2. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein generating the at least [[a]] one distance metric comprises:
generating a plurality of hypotheses by creating a plurality of labels, wherein each label of the plurality of labels represents a diagnostic feature associated with one or more hypotheses within the plurality of hypotheses;
identifying at least [[a]] one hypothesis from the plurality of hypotheses by matching the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature of the plurality of biomedical features against at least a label of the plurality of labels; and
generating the at least [[a]] one distance metric as a function of the at least [[a]] one hypothesis.
3. (Canceled)
4. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein:
the biomedical data includes at least [[an]] one electrocardiogram (ECG); and
the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature includes at least [[an]] one ECG feature identified from the at least [[an]] one ECG.
5. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein:
the biomedical data includes time series data; and
the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature includes at least [[a]] one feature identified from the time series data.
6. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein extracting the plurality of biomedical features comprises:receiving feature extraction training data comprising a plurality of training images as inputs and a plurality of training biomedical features as outputs;
training a feature extraction model by correlating the plurality of training images with the plurality of training biomedical features; and
extracting the plurality of biomedical features from the image using the trained feature extraction model.
7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein receiving the at least one image of biomedical data comprises:
extracting a plurality of biomedical parameters from the at least one image of biomedical data;
converting the plurality of biomedical parameters to one or more digitized signals; and
transforming the one or more digitized signals into an in-silicon image.
8. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 7, wherein receiving the at least one image of biomedical data further comprises:validating the one or more digitized signals, comprising:
classifying the one or more digitized signals to a plurality of preliminary parameters; and
determining an accuracy status of the plurality biomedical parameters by comparing the plurality of preliminary parameters to the plurality of biomedical parameters; and
generating a quality diagnostic of the biomedical data based on [[the]] a result of the validation.
9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein highlighting the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image comprises generating a color- coded heat map at one or more regions within the at least one image.
10. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 9, wherein generating the color-coded heat map comprises:generating a plurality of color-coded regions as a function of the at least [[a]] one distance metric; and
displaying, using the display device, the plurality of color-coded regions.
11. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a user interface,wherein highlighting the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image comprises:
receiving, using the user interface, a user query from a user; and
highlighting, using the user interface, the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image as a function of the user query.
12. (Currently Amended) A method for identifying at least one abnormal biomedical feature[[s]] within at least one image[[s]] of biomedical data, the method comprising:
capturing, using an image capture device, the at least one [[an]] image of biomedical data pertaining to a first patient;
receiving, by a processor from the image capture device, the at least one image of biomedical data;
extracting, by the processor, a plurality of biomedical features as a function of the biomedical data;
receiving, by the processor, repository data from a medical repository as a function of the plurality of biomedical features;
generating, by the processor, at least [[a]] one distance metric as a function of the plurality of biomedical features and the repository data;
highlighting, by the processor,the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image as a function of the at least [[a]] one distance metric; [[and]] identifying, by the processor, within the medical repository at least one second patient associated with at least one similar distance metric, wherein:a first set of statistical parameters are extracted as a function of the at least one image, and at least one second set of statistical parameters are extracted as a function of at least one image associated with the at least one second patient; and
identifying the at least one second patient comprises matching the first set of statistical parameters with the at least one second set of statistical parameters using a statistical model; and displaying, using a display device, the at least [[a]] one highlighted abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image.
13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein generating the at least [[a]] one distance metric comprises:generating a plurality of hypotheses by creating a plurality of labels, wherein each label of the plurality of labels represents a diagnostic feature associated with one or more hypotheses within the plurality of hypotheses;
identifying at least [[a]] one hypothesis from the plurality of hypotheses by matching the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature of the plurality of biomedical features against at least a label of the plurality of labels; and
generating the at least [[a]] one distance metric as a function of the at least [[a]] one hypothesis.
14. (Canceled)
15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein:the biomedical data includes at least [[an]] one electrocardiogram (ECG); and
the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature includes at least [[an]] one ECG feature identified from the at least [[an]] one ECG.
16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein:the biomedical data includes time series data; and
the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature includes at least [[a]] one feature identified from the time series data.
17. (Original) The method of claim 12, wherein extracting the plurality of biomedical features comprises:receiving feature extraction training data comprising a plurality of training images as inputs and a plurality of training biomedical features as outputs;
training a feature extraction model by correlating the plurality of training images with the plurality of training biomedical features; and
extracting the plurality of biomedical features from the image using the trained feature extraction model.
18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein receiving the at least one image of biomedical data comprises:extracting a plurality of biomedical parameters from the at least one image of biomedical data;
converting the plurality of biomedical parameters to one or more digitized signals; and
transforming the one or more digitized signals into an in-silicon image.
19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18, wherein receiving the at least one image of biomedical data further comprises:
validating the one or more digitized signals, comprising:
classifying the one or more digitized signals to a plurality of preliminary parameters; and
determining an accuracy status of the plurality biomedical parameters by comparing the plurality of preliminary parameters to the plurality of biomedical parameters; and
generating a quality diagnostic of the biomedical data based on [[the]] a result of the validation.
20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein highlighting the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image comprises generating a color- coded heat map at one or more regions within the at least one image.
21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein generating the color-coded heat map comprises:generating a plurality of color-coded regions as a function of the at least [[a]] one distance metric; and
displaying, using the display device, the plurality of color-coded regions.
22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein highlighting the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image comprises:receiving, using a user interface, a user query from a user; and
highlighting, using the user interface, the at least [[a]] one abnormal biomedical feature within the at least one image as a function of the user query.
